notes: Round2 refresh reads every assigned production file and reparses all TS/TSX/JSON; read/parse is not manual semantic verification.
Current focused review flags only modules with branches/call sites reread during round2. Prior flags are retained separately and must not be counted as fresh manual review.
Unchanged SHA enables referencing previous review evidence without claiming retest. Changed large JSON is syntax/schema/registered-content smoke coverage, not every sentence semantic reading.
Renderer 3389-line module receives targeted deep review of workers/siblings/travel/hair integration; all branches were not manually reverified.
No screenshot or device pixel verification performed by this subagent. Root browser verification is separate.
Existing tests, scripts and generated assets are excluded from assigned production totals; gallery hash integrity was additionally inspected.
